recipe.visualDefinition: A complex layered composition featuring a high-contrast close-up of a woman's face with heavy 1960s eye makeup, overlaid with a full-body shot of the same woman in a patterned mod dress, set against a warm, psychedelic circular background.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the extreme close-up face and the smaller full-body figure.
Transparency interaction where the patterned dress texture bleeds into the facial features.
Alignment of typography to the top right quadrant, balancing the heavy visual weight of the left-side face.
Chromatic harmony between the orange/pink dress patterns and the warm-toned background halo.
coreInvariants: Heavy black eyeliner and mascara on the close-up eyes.
Circular or 'halo' framing element in the background.
Right-aligned, flush-right text block for the primary titles.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 70% of the frame on the left; the secondary figure is centered-right and scaled down to 40% height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark-lashed eye on the left serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large eye, moves down the nose to the secondary figure, then up to the right-aligned text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with overlapping textures and figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and deep blacks provide the structural base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and magenta in the dress pattern provide rhythmic contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Teal used sparingly in technical metadata text to pop against the warm background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face (bright skin vs. black hair/lashes) paired with high saturation in the geometric patterns.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except for small accent text
Primary palette: Burnt Orange, Magenta, Peach, Black

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on clean, modernist typesetting

composition.relationshipToImage: Provides a clean horizontal anchor to the organic shapes

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors to distinguish artist from title.
graphicDevices: Small technical serial numbers in corners

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century editorial weight and punch.
Matches the geometric 'O' and 'G' shapes typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a double exposure photograph. The base layer is a high-contrast close-up of a woman's face with 1960s mod makeup. The second layer is a full-body shot of the same woman in a patterned orange and pink dress. The background should feature a soft-focus circular halo in warm tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top right. Use white for the artist name and a vibrant orange for the title. Include small technical metadata in the corners in a teal-colored sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the double exposure transparency visible through the dress?
Is the color palette dominated by warm oranges and pinks?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the double exposure transparency
Hue of the accent text (Teal vs. White)

mustAchieve: High-contrast black and white elements within the face

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean typographic edges against the textured background.
Ensure the eyes are the sharpest point of the composition.
Verify the 'halo' effect doesn't overwhelm the subject.
Confirm the color of the title text matches the dress pattern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered Portrait + Geometric Pattern + Right-Aligned Bold Sans-Serif = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic
